entities.name: Shuntaro Hida
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Shuntaro Hida  was a Japanese physician who was an eyewitness when the Little Boy atomic bomb was dropped on Hiroshima by the Enola Gay on 6 August 1945. He treated survivors as a medical doctor and wrote about the effects of radiation on the human body.
